```
['run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and optional targets to compute logits and loss', 'run the DistributedDataLoader to load and iterate over binary token data shards across distributed processes', 'build a GPTConfig dataclass to configure block size, vocab size, number of layers, heads, and embedding dimensions', 'run the CausalSelfAttention module with rotary embeddings and scaled dot product attention on input tensors', 'run the rmsnorm function to apply root mean square layer normalization to a tensor with configurable epsilon']
```
